CustomField.description: Manual ops flag: check to mark this extraction for re-run. OrderFormBackfillBatch.runRerunFlagged() re-extracts the linked Opportunity and links the new row to this one via Supersedes__c. The flag clears once a re-extraction at least as good becomes current; a failed or thinner rerun leaves it set so it can be retried.
CustomField.label: Rerun
